description: The file defines a Liquibase custom change class 'ConceptValidatorChangeSet' which performs validation and cleanup tasks on concept names in the OpenMRS database, ensuring data integrity and conformity to system constraints following concept name conversions.

classes.name: ConceptValidatorChangeSet
classes.description: A class implementing a Liquibase custom task to validate and update concept names in the database after concept name conversions, ensuring consistency and constraints adherence.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Performs validation and cleanup of concepts in the database, batching updates, and logs warnings and messages.

methods.name: validateAndCleanUpConcepts
methods.description: Validates concepts, enforces name uniqueness, sets default names, and verifies constraints across all unretired concepts.

methods.name: writeWarningsToFile
methods.description: Writes accumulated warnings and messages to a log file.

methods.name: setFullySpecifiedName
methods.description: Assigns a fully specified name to a concept based on available names and system constraints.

methods.name: reportUpdatedName
methods.description: Records an updated ConceptName and logs a message about the change.

methods.name: getAllUnretiredConceptIds
methods.description: Fetches all concept IDs from the concept table where retied = 0.

methods.name: isNameUniqueInLocale
methods.description: Checks if a concept name is unique among all unretired, non-voided names in the database.

methods.name: getAllowedLocalesList
methods.description: Retrieves list of allowed locales from global properties, sets default locale.

methods.name: getLocaleConceptNamesMap
methods.description: Fetches all non-voided concept names for a concept, grouped by locale.

methods.name: runBatchUpdate
methods.description: Executes batch update of concept names that have been modified.

methods.name: getInt
methods.description: Executes a SQL query returning a single integer result, e.g., count queries.
